UUREASON FOR REFERRALUU: Diagnostic test for Spinal Muscular Atrophy.
UUTEST

Test for copy number of exons 7 and 8 of the SMN1 gene by MLPA.

UURESULTS

SMN1 
exon 7: TWO copies detected


exon 8: TWO copies detected

UUSUMMARYUU 

This result indicates that it is extremely unlikely (significantly <1%) that the clinical phenotype is due to mutations in the SMN1 gene. However, if there remains a definite clinical diagnosis of SMA, then screening for point mutations in the SMN1 gene may be offered.  

UUNotes

Exons 7 and 8 (or 7 only) of the survival motor neuron 1 (SMN1) gene are homozygously absent in approximately 94% of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) patients. The remaining SMA patients are either compound heterozygotes for SMN1 mutations, or have an SMA phenotype unrelated to SMN1 (Wirth (2000) Hum.Mut. 15 p228-237).
Multiplex Ligation-dependant Probe Amplification (MLPA) kit P060-B1 used to test SMN1 ex7 and ex8 copy number.
